summary: Li Bang International Corp Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the effectiveness of a Share Capital Reorganization and adoption of an amended and restated memorandum of association, approved at an EGM on April 30, 2026. The reorganization reduces par value from US$0.01 to US$0.00001 per share, reduces authorized capital from US$31,505,000 to US$35,000, and creates 3.15B Class A and 350M Class B shares. This is a structural capital change, not a special situation. No special situation terms apply; the filing is a routine corporate action.
